_comment: OX v1.0 CORE book — all-weather risk-parity core leg. Each tick it estimates realized volatility for the full sleeve basket (crypto majors + equity indices + metals + energy + FX, intersected with the live board), computes INVERSE-VOL weights w_i = (1/vol_i)/sum(1/vol_j) over the WHOLE basket, and sizes each un-held sleeve LONG at marginUsd = portfolioBudgetPct * accountValue * w_i, capped at maxWeightPct of equity. Low leverage (3x), low turnover (600s tick). Knife guard: declines to ADD a sleeve in a hard 4h downtrend; existing sleeves are held through drawdowns by the DSL. Pairs with the BALLAST book (ox-ballast-config.json) on a SEPARATE wallet. Set wallet/strategyId/chatId. Runtime owns position tracking, caps, cooldowns, DSL via runtime-core.yaml. Producer launched with OX_LEG=core. NOTE: Ox's risk parity depends on the runtime honoring the per-sleeve signal.data.marginUsd (not a flat margin_pct).
_persona: All-weather risk-parity core — always invested, vol-balanced LONG basket across asset-class sleeves, inverse-vol sized so no sleeve dominates risk. Low leverage, low turnover, wide let-it-hold DSL. The fund line's steady core, not a directional bet. portfolioBudgetPct = gross deployed; maxWeightPct caps any single low-vol sleeve.
